name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd
title: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd - 544717 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Operational capacity 3.1 GW with 2.6 GW contracted and 1,500 MW FY27 addition guided at minimum; reported EBITDA up 28% to INR1,295 crore, but 13% of run-rate EBITDA faces Rajasthan CTU curtailment (Bikaner substation ~30%).

utilisation.quote: our achieved grid uptime continues to be well in excess of 99%

capex.quote: we would have at least 1,500 MW or 1.5 GW of RE Power Sales capacity addition in financial year 26-27

triggers.label: FY27 addition guided at least 1,500 MW
triggers.quote: we would have at least 1,500 MW or 1.5 GW of RE Power Sales capacity addition in financial year 26-27

triggers.label: Data & AI share 14% to 42% of contracts
triggers.quote: our 42% of our contracted capacity is with Data and AI

triggers.label: Bikaner CTU substation curtailment ~30%
